sources.title: NABO Focus No. 137: 2025 national tax revenue results and the causes of changes by tax (2025년 국세수입 실적 및 세목별 증감원인)
sources.note: Table 1 gives the 2025 actual revenue of each national tax in trillion won (income tax 130.5, corporate tax 84.6, VAT 79.2, …, “other” 25.7). The text gives the rural special tax as 9.2 trillion won and the comprehensive real estate tax as 4.7. “Other” covers stamp tax, prior-year revenue, education tax, liquor tax, rural special tax and so on.

sources.periodCovered: Tax law changes applying from 1 January 2026
sources.note: Table 13: corporate tax rates 9/19/21/24% (2025) rise to 10/20/22/25% from 2026. Table 18: education tax on financial and insurance companies’ revenue 0.5%, 1.0% on revenue above 1 trillion won from 2026. Table 9: separate taxation of dividends of high-dividend companies, 14%–30%, from dividends paid in 2026.
